title: Mock Battle Setup
prompt:
Wide training-ground setup. Student groups settle into loose formations while teachers observe. Training weapons and shields sit near the edge. Dust moves lightly in the sun. The shot establishes an organized school exercise, not a battlefield.

Camera: slow crane-like rise or gentle wide push.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. For war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful; show pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. No blood, gore, lethal impact, battlefield carnage, or real injury. Avoid: battlefield chaos, injuries, intense weapon clashes. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
